LanguageData.ARYASC_enable_cut_stump_Label: Automatically Designate The Stump For Chopping ?
LanguageData.ARYASC_Stump_NoRestart: Default: ✔ Tall trees will have their stump chopped right after being chopped. Changing this will NOT require a restart!
LanguageData.ARYASC_enable_cut_blight_Label: Automatically Designate Blighted Plants For Cutting ?
LanguageData.ARYASC_Blight_NoRestart: Default: ✘ Any future blight on plants will be immediately designated for cutting. Changing this will NOT require a restart!
LanguageData.ARYASC_enable_visual_Label: Chopped Tall Trees Have Falling Visual Effect ?
LanguageData.ARYASC_Visual_NoRestart: Default: ✔ Most tall trees will have a falling visual effect after being chopped. Changing this will NOT require a restart!
LanguageData.ARYASC_AllStumpsChop_Restart: Default: ✔ Show or hide the button "Chop stumps". Changing this will require a restart!
LanguageData.ARYASC_enable_FullyGrownTreesChop_Label: Enable the "Chop fully grown trees" order button ?
LanguageData.ARYASC_FullyGrownTreesChop_Restart: Default: ✘ Show or hide the button "Chop fully grown trees". Changing this will require a restart!
LanguageData.ARYASC_enable_FullyGrownCropsChop_Label: Enable the "Harvest fully grown crops" order button ?
LanguageData.ARYASC_FullyGrownCropsChop_Restart: Default: ✘ Show or hide the button "Harvest fully grown crops". Changing this will require a restart!
LanguageData.ARYASC_enable_messages_Label: Enable this mod's debug log messages ?
LanguageData.ARYASC_Messages_NoRestart: Default: ✘ You may need to enable the development mode. Changing this will NOT require a restart!
LanguageData.ARYASC_Reset_Settings: Click here to reset this mod to its default settings
LanguageData.Designator_AllStumpsChop_Descr: Marks stumps to be chopped down for wood.
LanguageData.Designator_FullyGrownTreesChop_Descr: Marks fully grown trees to be chopped down for wood. Most special trees, such as the anima tree, are not affected by this tool.
LanguageData.Designator_FullyGrownCropsChop_Descr: Marks fully grown plants to be harvested for their food or other products.
